headline: Holiday Magic Is Five Weeks Away
tagline: Halloween Time winds down while Disneyland's Christmas season, starting Nov 13, comes into focus.

lead.title: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort Kick Off Nov 13
lead.body: The holiday season starts a few days earlier than first planned and runs across both parks, Downtown Disney District and the resort hotels. Santa gets a new meet-and-greet spot at Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn, and Main Street, U.S.A. brings back its 60-foot Christmas tree.

events.title: Oogie Boogie Bash
events.body: The after-hours Halloween party at Disney California Adventure has 11 nights left, from tonight through Oct 31. Check the official calendar for exact dates before you go.

events.title: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: Both parks are decked out for the season through Halloween night.

events.title: Plaza de la Familia
events.body: A Día de los Muertos celebration with the Coco-inspired street show, live mariachi and a memory wall.

events.title: Cars Land Overlays
events.body: Luigi's Honkin' Haul-O-Ween and Mater's Graveyard JamBOOree are in their final weeks.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the Haunted Mansion runs into the new year.

events.title: Mickey's Trick and Treat
events.dates: Through Oct 31; showtimes in the app
events.body: The daytime Halloween show at the Disney Theater in Hollywood Land began Aug 18. Check the Disneyland app for current showtimes.

events.title: World of Color – One
events.body: The fan-favorite water show is back for a limited run before the holiday show takes over.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo, debuted in March. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Mike & Sulley to the Rescue!
events.body: The Monsters, Inc. ride at Disney California Adventure will now stay open into 2027 instead of closing in early 2026. A closing date has not been confirmed in the sources we found.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition returns with scenes from Beauty and the Beast and Inside Out. Performance schedule not yet announced.

events.title: Disney Festival of Holidays
events.body: Six festive food marketplaces return with new and returning bites, plus a Sip and Savor Pass of six digital coupons for food and non-alcoholic drinks.

events.title: Santa Meet-and-Greets
events.body: Santa appears at Redwood Creek Challenge Trail in DCA and at a new spot at Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn in Disneyland Park.

events.title: Holiday Fireworks, Parade and Overlays
events.body: "Believe… in Holiday Magic" fireworks, "A Christmas Fantasy Parade" and the it's a small world Holiday overlay all return.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: The collectible ornament hunt is expected to return to Downtown Disney District for the holidays; exact dates were not found.

tip: Disneyland has no separately ticketed holiday party, so holiday entertainment is included with park admission. Oogie Boogie Bash is the one Halloween event that needs its own ticket.
caveats: Dates come from Disney press releases and fan sites as of Oct 8, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
